column1: # Source changes verified NOT to affect any benchmarked path.
# The freshness guard fails when a pallet's lib.rs or benchmarking.rs is newer
# than its weights.rs, because stale weights under-count storage access and
# under-charge extrinsics. A source change does not always move a benchmarked
# path, though, and regenerating in that case only adds measurement noise (the
# bench run can inflate a result 40-80%).
# An entry here says: "at this commit, the change was read and it does not touch
# any `#[pallet::call]`, so the committed weights still describe the code."
# Entries are matched against the pallet's newest source commit, so the next
# commit to that pallet re-arms the guard on its own. Never add an entry to
# silence a change you have not read.
